page.layout: One column of running text, notes in the right margin, and at the foot a signature at left and a catchword at right.

marginalia.note: Gloff. in cap. Re-baptizar. de confc. crat. di. ftinct. 4.
Zyp. Pont. Nov. Annal. Enarrat. libr. 5. tit. de Pugnanc. in duell.

page.notes: The right-margin notes are read from a small, cramped print; "Gloff. in cap. Re-baptizar. de confc. crat. di. ftinct. 4." and the Zypæus references ("Annal. Enarrat. libr. 5. tit. de Pugnanc.") are doubtful in their abbreviations, and I have transcribed them as printed as far as I can see them. "præcisista" is read with its long s as printed. The word at the foot "re-" is the catchword and "N" the signature. No other marks are visible on the page; the faint text in the lower right corner is a digitiser's watermark and is left out.
